prompt:
Add a new Rust module `src-tauri/src/backend/training_pairs.rs` — the backend that reads Devboule's local self-improvement rail (the `.aspis-training/*.jsonl` files of {rejected, chosen} training pairs) so the app can display them. Implement EXACTLY:

1. `use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};` and `use std::path::Path;`
2. struct `TrainingPair` (derive Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq) with these pub String/bool fields, each `#[serde(default)]` so a JSONL line missing a key still parses: `origin: String`, `gate: String`, `rejected: String`, `chosen: String`, `scorer: String`, `judge_free: bool`.
3. `pub fn load_training_pairs(dir: &Path) -> Vec<TrainingPair>`: read every file in `dir` whose name ends in `.jsonl`; for each, parse it line by line, deserializing each non-empty line with `serde_json::from_str::<TrainingPair>(line)` and KEEPING only the lines that parse (skip blank lines and any malformed/non-JSON line — never panic). Files that are not `*.jsonl` are ignored. A missing/unreadable directory yields an empty Vec (no panic). Return all parsed pairs.

Idiomatic, warning-free, no unwrap()/expect() in non-test code (handle IO/parse errors by skipping), doc comments on public items. You MAY include a #[cfg(test)] mod tests (it will be ignored by scoring). Return ONLY the full file content.
